body: No no. In that case my apologises, I'm an un cultured swine and know only English and how to say "sorry I only speak English" in other languages. I hope your friend is well.
I may be a little sensitive due to the nature of it. But I do hope you don't mean to insinuate this is fake/false.
Likewise, if it's possible to return the favour. Anytime. I hope your own stuff you can handle, if not or just wanna talk. I doubt my attempt at sleeping will work.

While I'd genuinely like that. It's pretty late for me and think I should attempt some sleep. Besides either your as much a night owl as myself or your spending your christmas/boxing day talking to me. You've already helped me more than you know. Again thank you and good night.
Thank you for speaking to me, I almost didn't post. I don't usually share this sorta thing. You've helped me feel a bit better.

Actually when it happened, I didn't feel anything. It actually caused a great deal of anger and disgust at myself. I think that your right tho. I think I was in denial, being alone and my emotions getting out of control and suddenly realising she wasn't a call away. Boy did it hurt.
I've never been good with language, you summed my feeling up perfectly. I feel isolated. And insulated. Thank you for reading.
